records.context: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their background execution unit state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#1
records.source: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their worker-thread state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.
records.translation: Las wheels de Torch, scikit-learn y XGBoost pueden cargar entornos de ejecución LLVM OpenMP independientes en un mismo proceso. Cruzar el estado de sus hilos de trabajo puede terminar el proceso, sobre todo cuando ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suprime la protección del entorno de ejecución contra la inicialización duplicada.

records.context: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting independent execution path. This serializes that independent execution path's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#2
records.source: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting thread. records.source: Storage of an OPS run's tables, and the check that its objects exist.
records.translation: Almacenamiento de las tablas de una ejecución OPS, y la comprobación de que sus objetos existen.

records.context: SQLite is authoritative and Parquet is a cache. The two can disagree, so one of them has to be right by definition -- otherwise a reader that picked the faster one would sometimes be reading yesterday's numbers with no way to tell. :func:`write_table` writes both in one call and asserts the counts match before either is visible as complete; :func:`read_table` prefers the cache and falls back without complaining, because a missing cache is a performance question and not a correctness one.
records.label: spacr.ops_store#2
records.source: SQLite is authoritative and Parquet is a cache. The two can disagree, so one of them has to be right by definition -- otherwise a reader that picked the faster one would sometimes be reading yesterday's numbers with no way to tell. :func:`write_table` writes both in one call and asserts the counts match before either is visible as complete; :func:`read_table` prefers the cache and falls back without complaining, because a missing cache is a performance question and not a correctness one.
records.translation: SQLite es la fuente autorizada y Parquet es una caché. Ambos pueden discrepar, así que uno de ellos tiene que tener razón por definición -- de lo contrario, un lector que eligiera el más rápido leería a veces los números de ayer sin forma de saberlo. :func:`write_table` escribe ambos en una sola llamada y comprueba que los recuentos coinciden antes de que cualquiera de ellos sea visible como completo; :func:`read_table` prefiere la caché y recurre a la otra fuente sin quejarse, porque una caché ausente es una cuestión de rendimiento y no de corrección.

records.context: Permutation inference assumes that residuals can be exchanged within each block. records.source: Permutation inference assumes that residuals can be exchanged within each block. records.translation: La inferencia por permutación supone que los residuos pueden intercambiarse dentro de cada bloque. Background is estimated per guide because barcode-specific effects can differ substantially. The module also separates two operations with different interpretations:
records.translation: Los pocillos de control con composición de guías conocida ofrecen observaciones directas de lecturas asignadas a guías que deberían estar ausentes. El fondo se estima por guía porque los efectos específicos de cada código de barras pueden diferir sustancialmente. El módulo también separa dos operaciones con interpretaciones distintas:

records.context: exclusion removes sequences that cannot be present in cells, such as primer or plasmid carry-over, before fractions are calculated;
